{{Quote|My mother was human. My father was a ghost in the night, and I doubt even my mother knew his species&mdash;but it was obviously a long-lived one. If I ever find out who he was, perhaps I'll be able to hunt him down and kill him.|Aurra Sing|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>}}
This '''species''' had chalk white skin, sunken black eye sockets, and fingers with one more joint than a [[Human/Legends|Human]] finger. Their long fingers were used for drawing blood. The lifespan of this species was much longer than that of a human. [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing's]] [[Aurra Sing's father/Legends|father]] was a member of this species.

The species of Aurra Sing's father was speculated by the people that she worked for to have been [[Qiraash/Legends|Qiraash]], [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]], [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]], or even [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]], despite the fact that none of these could interbreed with [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="CNII">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
